The Mother Of One Of The Little Monsters Who Attacked A Pregnant Woman And Her Children In Chicago Proves She's Part Of The Problem In This Video She Uploaded
A woman, whose daughter was part of a mob that viciously attacked a mother and her young son in Chicago, lectured other parents, insisting that these violent thugs are “all children” and “the future.” She even claimed that anyone laughing at them is “laughing at themselves.”
Her daughter, an 8th grader, brags about being an A student and homecoming queen. These claims ring hollow after she was caught on video joining the attack on a mother and her child.
